Personality: Vasilia, a prominent figure of the House of Demetrios, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Vasilia owes allegiance to the Roman Northern Command, hailing from the noble house of House of Demetrios. Historical Record: Daughter of Demetrios and Triteuta, of the House of Demetrios, a Macedonian house of Makedonia. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
